The historical pre-reader Definition calls I times R2 open for every allowed interval I; I=[0,1] disproves that claim. Independently checked current Definition: domain-relative phase equation is defined on I, an open-domain first-order system is asserted only for open J, and Picard-Lindelof is limited to interior times with an endpoint-extension disclaimer. Lipschitz constant is valid. Historical error is real and current correction is sound; the original pre binding and preserved producer manifest give historical evidence, not an unbound observation. Batch-7 manifest still needs owner synchronization; this closure does not clear the two producer classification domain findings.

Missing supplier interface: specify I=R for the global autonomous oscillator model, or explicitly distinguish solutions of a restricted model J subset I from solutions of its global equation. Current producer Statement still quantifies over J subset R and x:R without fixing I; I=[0,1] is allowed by the cited Definition. Independently read current proof, batch-7 contract and manifest, and exact local-uniqueness/derivative suppliers. Explicit families, nonzero value/derivative determinants, arbitrary interior-time matching and endpoint continuity prove the intended global equation classification, but do not repair that model-domain interface. Attempted closure: checked those families and uniqueness in full; no additional substantial analytic result is needed. Producer is outside batch-12 edit scope. Owner batch 7 must correct/resolve the public domain and synchronize contract/manifest, then dispose of affected consumers before closure. See report for exact source IDs and checkpoints.
